title: Quietly Crispy Canadian Baby Aubergine Flatbread
description: A plant-based Canadian dish featuring crispy baby aubergine on a long-fermentation dough flatbread, perfect for a brunch mood, served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the long-fermentation dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Place the dough in a terracotta dish and brush with olive oil.
Arrange the sliced baby aubergine on the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and dried oregano over the aubergine.
Drizzle the maple syrup over the aubergine and seasonings.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the crust is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
